newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank sets two bill auctions for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank sets two bill auctions for Wednesday.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday it would auction two unspecified tranches of its liquidity bills on Wednesday.
The NBS said one tranche would have a maturity of eight-weeks while the second would be three month bills.
It did not give further details of the two Dutch-style auctions, both scheduled for 1300 CET (1100 GMT).
In its last successful auction of three month bills on August 28, the NBS set the yield at 9.3 percent.
